cohort: 745 pregnant women who underwent cesarean section at Obstetrics and Gynaecology department of Quaid-e-Azam International Hospital Islamabad and PAF hospital Masroor, Karachi.
finding: The prevalence of blood transfusion among women undergoing cesarean section was 10.1%, and the risk of transfusion increased with placenta previa, preoperative maternal anemia, placenta abruption, and second stage cesarean section.
